notes.title: Bugfix and reduced game difficulty for a better experience.
notes.content:
We received poor reviews on the game experience due to its difficulty, and a poor experience using the GUI and translations. We have therefore corrected all the problems found and reduced the difficulty of the game.

Please, if you find a bug or have a bad experience with the game, contact me by email: [b]support@imaginary-conception.com[/b]

And so I will correct that right away. Thanks !
